guard: publishable @cotal-ai/seat trees carry native linux-x64 and linux-arm64 SO_PEERCRED helpers, load by process.arch, and refuse an unsupported arch
why: The ARM load job consumes the same packed tarball. A host pnpm build is one arch and must not pack. These windows are the four cells owed for that split.

mutations.name: M1 skip arm64 completeness in the pack gate
mutations.expectRed: one-arch tree is refused before pack
mutations.cell: one-arch tree is refused before pack
mutations.note: Dropping linux-arm64 from the shipped list lets a host-only tree pack.

mutations.name: M2 ignore process.arch when choosing the helper
mutations.expectRed: loader selects the host arch helper
mutations.cell: loader selects the host arch helper
mutations.note: A fixed path cannot load the host helper on both linux-x64 and linux-arm64.

mutations.name: M3 skip arm64 copy in assemble
mutations.expectRed: assemble copies both native builder artifacts
mutations.cell: assemble copies both native builder artifacts
mutations.note: PR pack, Changesets, and snapshot share this copy step. Skipping arm64 ships one arch.

mutations.name: M4 soften unsupported-arch copy
mutations.find: `@cotal-ai/seat: SO_PEERCRED native helper unsupported on ${platform}-${arch} (supported: linux-x64, linux-arm64)`,
mutations.note: The owed loud-fail names linux-x64 and linux-arm64 rather than a generic skip.

mutations.name: M5 drop the prepack gate
mutations.expectRed: host-only pnpm pack is refused by prepack
mutations.cell: host-only pnpm pack is refused by prepack
mutations.note: prepublishOnly does not run on pnpm pack. Removing prepack lets a host-only tree pack.
